_note: Source copy and context hints for the three ad groups. The live setup is one campaign with three ad groups in the PriceMyNewRoof, LLC ad account; see campaign-live.json for IDs. (This file's per-group campaign/budget blocks describe the original three-campaign draft and are kept for reference.)

campaign.name: Price My New Roof - Cost research
campaign.description: Roof replacement estimate, cost research intent. Clicks, $3 max CPC.

ad_group.name: Cost research
context_hints: Homeowners asking how much a new roof or roof replacement costs, what a fair price is for replacing a roof, how roofing quotes are calculated, cost per square or per square foot for asphalt shingle or tile roofs, or how to budget for a roof replacement on their house.

creative.title: What should a new roof cost for your house?
creative.body: Enter your address. We measure your roof from satellite data and estimate the price. Free.

campaign.name: Price My New Roof - Tile roofs
campaign.description: Roof replacement estimate, tile roofs intent. Clicks, $3 max CPC.

ad_group.name: Tile roofs
context_hints: Homeowners with concrete or clay tile roofs asking about replacing tile roof underlayment, tile lift and relay, whether to keep their tiles or replace the whole roof, how long tile roof underlayment lasts, or the cost of replacing a tile roof.

creative.title: Keep your tiles or replace the whole roof?
creative.body: See estimates for tile lift and relay, new tile and shingle, priced for your roof's size.

campaign.name: Price My New Roof - Repair or replace
campaign.description: Roof replacement estimate, repair or replace intent. Clicks, $3 max CPC.

ad_group.name: Repair or replace
context_hints: Homeowners with an old, aging, or leaking roof deciding whether to repair it or replace it, asking how to tell if a roof needs replacing, how long a roof lasts, or what to expect when getting a roof replaced.

ad.name: Repair or replace - chat card v1

creative.title: See what replacing your roof would cost
creative.body: Before you decide to repair or replace, get a free estimate based on your roof's measurements.
